name: alakazam741_v11_board_depth
archetype: Alakazam 741 + Dudunsparce with board-depth and Fezandipiti fallback
summary: Preserves v10 attack discipline while reducing mulligans and board-wipe losses. Adds Fezandipiti ex and Shaymin, raises Poké Pad and Dawn to four, models independent Alakazam routes, deepens second-player setup, and keeps Hyper Aroma as the sole ACE SPEC.
notes: Deck contains 60 cards and nine Basic Pokémon instead of seven.
Hyper Aroma is the only ACE SPEC; Enriching Energy is not included.
Battle Cage 3->1, Night Stretcher 3->2, Lillie's Determination 1->0.
Fezandipiti ex 0->1, Shaymin 0->1, Poké Pad 3->4, Dawn 3->4.
Energy remains Basic Psychic 3 plus Telepath Psychic Energy 4.
Independent route depth replaces the old raw Abra+Kadabra+Alakazam body-count cap.
Second-player opening targets three represented Alakazam routes but never overrides attack-preservation gates.
Fezandipiti is conditional recovery/fallback; it is not automatically benched and is not funded before the primary Alakazam route.
Shaymin is deployed only when the opposing board contains a bench-damage threat and a relevant bench needs protection.
Enhanced Hammer remains lock-first and gains a tempo mode only when removal leaves every opposing attack at least two attachments short.
Boss's Orders remains absent; Xerosic remains mirror-only.
Python syntax and 25 API-stub Golden-state tests pass. Real-engine ladder strength is not yet measured.
